executive_messages: 9 machines in inventory (4 Azure VMs and 5 hybrid Azure Arc servers): 6 assessed by Update Manager and 3 with no assessment telemetry.
2 per-machine maintenance cycles recorded in the window (1 'UpdateSuccessfullyApplied' versus 1 'ShutdownOrUnresponsive') and 2 patchInstallationResults runs.
1 Azure Arc server has the agent in state 'Expired'/'Disconnected', which blocks assessment and patch deployment.
2 machines have assessments stuck in 'InProgress' with vmGuestPatchReadiness='UnableToDetermine', and 2 servers have pending Security/UpdateRollUp patches with no maintenance window assigned.
Automated root-cause diagnosis generated for 9 machines (9 technical findings correlated across ARG, extensions, Hotpatch and maintenance windows), without signing in to any machine.

machines.investigation_headline: Azure Connected Machine agent (azcmagent) in state 'Expired' since 2026-06-09T10:42:11Z (version 1.61.03319.2737).
machines.root_cause_evidence: The hybrid Azure Arc server sends no heartbeat to the Microsoft.HybridCompute control plane. With the agent in state 'Expired', Azure Update Manager cannot deploy the assessment extension or run scheduled maintenance windows.
machines.recommended_human_action: Check whether the physical or virtual server is still in service or should be removed from Azure Arc. all_detected_issues.root_cause_evidence: The hotpatchStatus object in patchassessmentresources reports code 'HotpatchEnablementRequiredForReadiness' ("[Hotpatching must be enabled for the VM to be hotpatch ready.]."). methodology.scheduled_cadence_description: Day 1 of every month at 08:00 UTC (plus on-demand runs after a patching window).
limitations: 100% read-only collection through the Azure Resource Graph API (2022-10-01); the tool never runs guest commands (runCommand) and never starts or stops machines.
Sensitive or private extension configuration blocks are never requested or exported.
Local log paths shown by Azure Update Manager (for example WindowsPatchExtension) come from the error message reported to the ARM control plane.
